curation: Ported from rules/vllm-v0.29/quant_compute_capability.json (rule_version 4, mechanism_verified) to vLLM v0.30.0: every cited line re-found in the pinned v0.30.0 source. A hypothesis on v0.30.0 until a v0.30.0 boot proves it; the v0.29.0 proof does not carry over. The source scanner must not overwrite this file. model_executor/layers/quantization/fp_quant.py and cmake/external_projects/qutlass.cmake are byte-identical to v0.29.0: fp_quant.py:198-209 still registers forward_hadamard_matrix only, so substitute_artifact and kernel_architectures carry over unchanged. Carried over from the v0.29.0 rule: v2 replaces retarget_capability with substitute_artifact (PLAN §10.1 fallback). Evidence: v1's fix moved ISTA-DASLab/Qwen3-0.6B-FPQuant-RTN-MXFP4 to a B200; the capability check passed, then weight loading failed ('no module or parameter named ...backward_hadamard_matrix', boot report 1220e2bb9d9e3077ec36a3b1996d3fa982eb9268665a8054c69a161934461b3fd41d, 2026-09-27). v0.29.0 fp_quant.py:198-209 registers forward_hadamard_matrix only, and all 32 FPQuant checkpoints on the Hub store backward_hadamard_matrix (safetensors headers, 2026-09-27), so no GPU makes them load. substitute_artifact serves the same network in a format the pinned engine runs on the requested GPU. kernel_architectures still excludes fp_quant candidates on GPUs its kernels were not built for.
